selected_evidence.requirement: Password policy: minlen=12 and minclass=3 configured and enforced on node1 (pre-restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Discovered pam_pwquality wired into PAM, wrote minlen=12/minclass=3 config, and confirmed via pwscore that a short password and a fewer-than-3-class password are rejected while a compliant 12-char 3-class password is accepted.

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before node1 restart (boot identity + policy enforcement proof)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (377b5195-7fea-4219-a67b-044ef3f7ab99) and confirmed pwquality.conf.d file present and enforcing (short password rejected).

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background; acknowledgement (pid) returned to caller before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 became unreachable then recovered with a changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Node1 timed out/reset during reboot, then responded again with a new boot_id 93f201a2-117a-4f4f-831d-b073dbf1ec3c, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required configuration/service state on node1 (only managed node, no cluster membership to verify)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot uptime shows a fresh boot time; pwquality.conf.d/90-complexity.conf persisted; pwscore confirms short and 2-class passwords are still rejected while a compliant 12-char/3-class password is accepted, matching pre-restart behavior.
